latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of AI Creativity Collaboration skill.
- Enables users to brainstorm, ideate, and overcome creative blocks with AI as a collaborative partner.
- Guides users through both divergent (idea generation) and convergent (filtering and refining) creative phases.
- Emphasizes user’s creative ownership—AI assists, but the human makes final decisions.
- Provides structured techniques such as random stimulus, role-play ideation, constraint-based creativity, and what-if expansion.
